preconditions.description: The number of tasks N must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of dependencies M must be between 0 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: len(E) == N and all(E[i] in {0, 1} for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: The list E must contain exactly N integers, each being either 0 or 1.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= T1 < N and 0 <= T2 < N and T1 != T2 for T1, T2 in dependencies)
preconditions.description: Each dependency (T1, T2) must be valid task indices and T1 must not equal T2.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimal number of coprocessor calls necessary to execute the program.
